title: Graphic Designer + Marketing Assistant + Video Editor
description:
Graphic Designer & Marketing Assistant (Home Renovation / Roofing)

Company: 2URN Marketing — performance marketing for roofing & home renovation contractors

Website:

Location: Remote (USA) — Standard hours 9:00–5:00 PM CDT

Type: Full-time (open to contractor-to-hire)

Why this role exists

We create ads that make the phone ring for roofers. You’ll turn raw ideas and footage into scroll-stopping creative, edit content fast, and support campaign execution. If you can edit content at a high level, you’re a #1-priority candidate—design skills matter, but content editing chops win.

What you’ll do (outcomes, not busywork)

  • Produce ad creative: Design static graphics and short-form video for Meta / TikTok / YouTube / Display; iterate quickly based on performance data.
  • Edit content end-to-end: Cut UGC, before / after, job-site clips; add captions, hooks, overlays, CTAs; ship multiple variations.
  • Build offer / angle packs: Translate roofing value props (financing, storm damage, warranties, same-day inspection) into hooks, headlines, and visuals.
  • Launch + maintain assets: Prep export specs, thumbnails, landing page hero graphics, and ad library organization.
  • Brand standards: Create and maintain lightweight brand kits per client (logos, palettes, typography, truck / crew photos).
  • Creative testing: Set up A / B creative matrices; document learnings; kill losers, scale winners.
  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)
  • 2 static ads (before / after + financing angle)
  • Project file + export settings + a one-page rationale

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for skill, speed, and integrity. All backgrounds welcome.

title: Executive Operations Integrator
description:
Overview

Role : Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics : We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry / salon space.

Contract : Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours : Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate : $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start : Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Here’s What You’ll Get To Work On:

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Here’s the experience we’re looking for:

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Here’s what we’re looking for this role to achieve:

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management: Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization: Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development: Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management: Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations

  • Reporting and Metrics: Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated: Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together

  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

Nice-to-haves :

Who You Are

Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers\' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties

  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Overview

AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS / CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50% : OCR → parse → validate → post touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance : Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑ : Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments / write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑ : Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑ : AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed : Live Sheets / Excel / Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor : MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines : OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation : Primary-source license checks, date / format rules, name / DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG / OT).
  • Workflow integrations : Event-driven APIs / webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM / Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation : AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS / CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies / MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record : Integrate VoIP / SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS / Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation : Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage / routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation : Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing / job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation : Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required) : Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to :
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits / adjustments.
  • Sync AR / AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants : RAG chatbots over Confluence / SharePoint / Drive / ATS / CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting : Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset / prompt / embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline / online evals; A / B tests.
  • CI / CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency / reliability SLOs; canary / blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries / backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces / metrics / cost), drift detection, PII / HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance : token / throughput controls, caching / TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and / or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM / RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF / HTML / images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA / PII ), APIs / webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS / Compliance / Job Boards / HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing / payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals : data / model versioning, CI / CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing / credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS / workflow tools (Zapier / Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS / App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI / LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership : Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover : Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack : Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM / Marketing (HubSpot / Salesforce) , VoIP / SMS, CMS, accounting / payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes : Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture : Production over prototypes, HIPAA / PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

Our client is a legal technology company that utilizes AI to help law firms work more efficiently. As a Staff Frontend Engineer , you will play a key role in designing and implementing core user-facing features, guiding frontend architecture, and shaping how users interact with the product. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and backend teams to ensure high-quality, accessible, and responsive interfaces. This role is ideal for an experienced frontend engineer who enjoys solving complex UI problems, mentoring others, and driving consistent, thoughtful user experiences in a fast-moving environment.

Interview Preparation Guide

Key Responsibilities

  • Frontend Development: Lead the development of intuitive, responsive user interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks and Tailwind CSS. Ensure accessibility, consistency, and performance across devices.
  • Architecture & Design Systems: Contribute to the evolution of our frontend architecture and design system. Define patterns and abstractions that promote code quality, maintainability, and development speed.
  • Real-Time Interfaces: Support real-time browser-based features by integrating with WebSocket-powered systems. Help ensure smooth, low-latency UI updates for features like in-browser voice interactions or live status indicators.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to scope and deliver cohesive, well-integrated features that align with user needs and product goals.

  • Code Quality & Best Practices: Drive high standards in frontend development through regular code reviews, testing, and mentorship. Help other engineers navigate frontend complexity and unblock progress.

Technical Proficiency

Must have experience with several of the following:

  • Front-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with strong experience in frameworks such as React, Vue.js, or Angular. Familiarity with CSS tooling like Tailwind is a plus.
  • Real-Time Interfaces: Experience building browser-based features that use WebSockets or similar technologies for real-time updates and interactivity.
  • UI/UX Implementation: Strong understanding of layout, accessibility, and design integration. Comfortable translating high-fidelity designs into reliable, user-friendly interfaces.
  • API Integration: Fluent in working with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs to connect frontend features to backend systems, including thoughtful handling of loading, errors, and edge cases.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Experience with automated frontend testing frameworks such as Jest, Cypress, or Testing Library. Strong focus on preventing regressions and maintaining confidence in releases.
  • Cloud Platforms & CI/CD: Familiarity with cloud-hosted frontend environments (e.g., on AWS or GCP) and with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI to support a stable deployment pipeline.

Qualifications

  • Experience : 8+ years in frontend development, with a proven track record of owning major UI projects and delivering high-quality, production-grade interfaces at scale.
  • Technical Expertise : Strong background in modern frontend architecture and development practices, including state management, performance tuning, and design system usage or implementation.
  • Problem Solving : Skilled at navigating complex user interaction problems and delivering clear, reliable solutions that balance technical constraints and user needs.
  • Collaboration : Able to work effectively within a cross-functional team and communicate clearly with designers, engineers, and product stakeholders.
  • Mentorship : Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a collaborative, growth-oriented engineering culture.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English

Position : Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location : Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours : Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date : Immediate

Contract Type : PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration : 3-4 months

Language Requirement : Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)

Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests : Rapidly learn product / domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites : Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation : Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit / xUnit / MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI / CD quality gates : Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines : Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging / preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle : Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation : Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger / OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes ( SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks : Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability : Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements / ACs.
  • Mentor & improve : Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.

Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and / or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET / .NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC / Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and / or Playwright , plus NUnit / xUnit / MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio / Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards / issues, and CI / CD pipelines.

title: Sales Lead
description:
Overview

Sales Lead – GoodParty.org is looking for a Sales Lead to help reinvent civic leadership in America. You will lead our high performing Top-of-Funnel outbound calling team. Your focus will shift throughout the year between initial candidate outreach and nurturing relationships to drive conversions to our product and service offerings. The ideal candidate excels in prospecting new leads, guiding a team, and deepening relationships with engaged users to promote product adoption.

About GoodParty.org :

GoodParty.org is on a mission to make people matter more than money in our democracy by empowering Independent candidates to run, win, and serve. Our AI-powered platform provides free tools to Independent candidates to run their campaigns, connect with voters, and serve their communities effectively.

A majority of eligible voters, including more than half of Millennials and Gen Z, say that neither Republicans nor Democrats represent them. GoodParty.org is the solution. In 2024 we empowered 3,444 Independent candidate wins across 48 states from all across the ideological spectrum. The elected officials we empower prioritize people over parties and community over corporate interests. In 2024, 40.3 million votes (26% of all voters) cast a ballot for our candidate users. We’re not a political party; we’re a platform and a movement to democratize democracy.

Founded by serial entrepreneur Farhad Mohit, GoodParty.org is building solutions so we can have a truly representative democracy where society’s biggest problems are solved.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and coach a team of contract outreach reps by coordinating daily/weekly priority call lists, setting pipeline goals, and ensuring high-quality, high-impact conversations.
  • Create and refine recommended talk tracks, email templates, call scripts, and objection handling guides to improve outreach conversion and candidate quality.
  • Monitor outreach performance and call quality, providing insights or resources to help reps improve results.
  • Own and execute candidate outreach at the top of the funnel, introducing prospective independent and nonpartisan candidates to GoodParty.org and sparking their interest in running for office using our tools.
  • Drive initial engagement by clearly communicating our mission, platform benefits, and the unique value of running independently with GoodParty.org’s support.
  • Manage a high-volume outreach pipeline in HubSpot, maintaining accurate records, tracking engagement, and ensuring consistent, personalized follow-ups.
  • When bandwidth allows, make outreach calls to contribute to top-of-funnel goals.
  • Pilot and implement new messaging strategies, tools, and AI enhancements – testing what works and scaling what doesn’t across the team.
  • Share top-of-funnel insights with internal teams to help inform platform positioning, marketing strategy, candidate personas, and product messaging.
  • Bring a startup mindset to everything you do by experimenting, learning fast, and iterating to drive candidate pipeline growth and readiness.
  • Report to the Senior Sales Manager who oversees all sales teams.

Who we’re looking for

  • You're up for the audacious challenge of driving money out of politics and democratizing democracy.
  • You have 4-5 years of experience in outreach, sales, or business development, 2+ years in tech sales with 1+ years experience as a team lead.
  • You're skilled at building trust with team members, moving conversations toward action.
  • You explain complex tools simply and clearly, and communicate expectations with confidence and empathy.
  • You're organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing pipelines in HubSpot while hitting engagement goals.
  • You're tech-savvy and already using AI tools that boost performance.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote, startup environment where you can make things happen without a lot of red tape.
  • You've trained or coached team members on talk tracks, objection handling, or outreach strategies.

Bonus if

  • You've used your outreach or sales skills in a social impact, nonprofit, or political environment, either professionally or as a volunteer.
  • You've built or optimized CRM workflows, automation sequences, or reporting dashboards—especially in high-volume outreach teams.
  • You've worked in civic tech, political campaigns, or democracy-focused initiatives and understand the unique challenges of this space.
  • You've deployed AI tools for outreach (e.g. call summarizers, email generators, or LLMs) to improve efficiency and personalization.

Why you should work at GoodParty.org

  • Join us in solving the biggest problem of our time – fixing our democracy – so all other problems can be solved.
  • We’re a Public Benefit Corporation that prioritizes social impact over profit.
  • Innovative Bitcoin-denominated deferred bonus plan, allowing you to have the amazing upside of being in a startup while working on a truly meaningful mission.
  • Work where and how you like, on a fully remote team spread across the country.
  • Join a passionate team with diverse political views focused on one mission.
  • 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents.
  • We encourage you to take time off to recharge and have an unlimited PTO policy.
  • 401(k) program available (no employer match).
  • Individual learning & development budget to fund your growth.
  • Workspace setup stipend to support remote work; $50/month for home internet if you work from home. Co-working can be discussed as an option.
  • Fully funded for our mission. No stress over funding rounds; focus on impact.

The salary range is $80,000-$90,000 + commission for this remote, full-time position with excellent benefits. This range reflects compensation at the time of posting. We may pay more or less than the posted range. Salary within range depends on factors including experience, skills, seniority, education, certifications, and organizational needs. We reserve the right to modify this pay range at any time.

We are not considering candidates currently based outside of the US, so please only apply if you are physically located in the US. Unfortunately, we are not able to provide sponsorship for any of our roles at this time.

Overview

Specialism: Operations – Wellsite Leader
Primary Reporting: Wells Superintendent

The Well Site Leader of the Future (WSLf) program is a structured program that will include Safety Leadership, Core Technical and Leadership Training to building Core Technical Skills, and Cross-Discipline learning / Broadening with a strong focus on Performance. The program also includes frequent progress reviews that will be used to verify that the WSLf candidates are progressing through the program. The Well Site Leader (WSL) role will support the planning and execution of well construction (drilling and completion), workovers, interventions, and subsea activities in alignment BP’s Who We Are framework, conformance with the requirements of BP’s Operating Management System (OMS), practices and procedures, and with local government regulations. The Well Site Leader of the Future (WSLf) candidate will be responsible for learning and building the vital skills and competencies to function in a Well Site Leader (WSL) role after they have completed (graduated) the program. The base case duration of the program is two to three years. The length of time the candidates spend in the program will depend on the level of skills to build, their pace of learning and the level of experience the candidates bring into the program. Successful candidates will report directly to the Well Superintendent (WSUP). They will work closely with the Well Site Leaders and Supervisors at the well site including all vendors, suppliers, and contractors.

Essential Role Requirements

Experience: Sufficient related well engineering or well operations experience including operator engineering experience. Experience working in and multi-disciplinary teams is helpful. Note: candidates with incremental validated experience will be considered in the selection process.

Qualifications: Communication skills at all levels to be able to optimally learn the skills and competencies associated with the Wellsite Leader role and leading multi-disciplinary scopes of work.

Education: Degree in engineering, science or technical field; Completion of WSLf training program may apply as part of the WSLf role and competency development plan dependent upon the experience of the selected candidates.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • The Development WSL will work as part of a team, under the direction of the Senior Wellsite Leader.
  • Promote an inclusive workplace where speak-up is the norm.
  • Follow the WSLf Program to learn, understand, develop, build skills and competencies in their core technical field including cross-discipline learning.
  • Lead with supervision in well operation activities.
  • Verifying alignment to the site Safety Management System (SMS), Control of Work (CoW) procedures, Barrier Health, Risk Management and Self-verification & Oversight (SV&O) processes.
  • Advocate “stop the job” and “speak up culture”.
  • Support the Senior WSL in reporting and documenting HSSE incidents, accidents and process safety events using the bp’s safety reporting system.
  • Support the WSL and well Engineering in all daily operations planning and lookahead forecasts with all onsite vendors, suppliers, and contractors including workload prioritization to allow proper supervision during critical well operations.
  • Leading the maximising Efficiency program to improve operational performance
  • Verify procedural rigor around work done per approved procedures, running operational changes, and site meetings such as pre-job, pre-tour, after action reviews (AAR) and lessons learned (LL) for continuous improvement.
  • Support the WSL in the Daily Operations Reports (using OpenWells) for accuracy and content, daily cost tracking process, and reviewing all service providers, vendors and contractor’s daily reports for content and accuracy prior to distribution.
  • Support and lead in contractors, suppliers, and vendors performance for all well operations such as KPI metrics; efficiency – productive, non-productive, and invisible lost time events, investigations, non-conformance; performance feedback.
  • Actively participate in assuring safe operations. Understand and support Stop the Job and speak up culture. Participate in risk assessments and in the event of any activity or program changes.

While Working Onshore

  • Support well planning and learning process through input into drilling procedures, forward programs and active participation in BP’s continuous improvement processes. Participate in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensure onsite lessons are gathered and shared effectively.
  • Management and control of operational costs. Actively pursue cost saving and innovative solutions for well work operations.
  • Develop and demonstrate communication skills in finding opportunities safety improvements and improvements in operational efficiency.
  • Support systematic sharing of takeaways and procedures identified and collected at the rig site.

Key Competencies

  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Field Specific: General Rig and Well Operations competency and development, Wellsite Leader leadership and competency development in-role.

Development & Training

  • CBSP training, water survival and other training as required to obtain approval for travel to the offshore wellsite.
  • Complete and close out gaps identified in WSL competency assessment.
  • Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF) for Drilling and Well Servicing for Surface and Subsea BOP desirable

Leadership and Behavioural Traits

  • Proactively lives BP’s Who We Are framework, including Code of Conduct
  • Informed Judgment: Uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe and driven Well Operations. Knows when to call out appropriate issues or request help. Focus on life-of-well reliability – a key outcome of well construction.
  • Commitment and Engagement: Shows personal commitment to delivering the plan, focused on Continuous Improvement
  • Systematic Management: Progresses operational excellence through systematic application of OMS
  • Leadership Presence: Demonstrates courage to safely handle risk
  • Accountability: Verifying expectations and accountabilities for safety compliance and performance are clear, accepted and delivered
  • Standout Colleague: Interfaces and enables others to realize their fullest potential
  • Safety Leader: Serves as a role model for others
  • Good Communication Skills: Able to connect with individuals of a diverse group of backgrounds, education and social status

Key Relationships

The Development WSL will need to cultivate relationships with the bp well operations team and with the rig contractors and well service personnel supporting the assigned rig. Other key relationships include the Wells Operations team and bp Wells Rigor Team (for engagement in training associated with skill development).

Site Or Region Specific Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • Develop an awareness and compliance to Local and Governmental regulations pertaining to wells Brasil operations.

Desirable Criteria & Qualifications

PPFG and geohazard principles for wells, Wellbore geomechanics, Drill string component selection, Drilling operations, Directional drilling, Drilling, Completion & Intervention fluids, Casing design, Tubular handling and installation for wells, Cementing, Drilling data acquisition and well monitoring, Run pressure drilling, Well operations under utmost conditions, Side-track operations, Casing and wellhead recovery, Wellbore fishing operations, Completion tubing design, Completion equipment & accessories, Sand control design, Intelligent Completions, Perforating, Wellbore cleanout, Well testing equipment & operations, Artificial lift, Fracturing and stimulation, Slickline and braided-line, Electric-line, Coiled-tubing, Rig workovers, Through-tubing fishing, Well interventions data acquisition, Subsea control systems for well operations, Completion landing string systems, Open-water riser and riser-less intervention systems, ROV deployment for well operations, Selection and design of subsea equipment, Subsea BOPs, Subsea tree systems, Subsea wellheads, Well control, Well intervention pressure control, Source control for wells, Crisis and emergency response management, Well barrier design, selection and construction, Well barrier operation, monitoring and maintenance, Well reliability. Equipment integrity assurance, Well productivity, Rig and vessel intake and start-up, Rig and vessel operations, Common process for wells activities, OMS and bp requirements, Risk Management, Process Safety Management, Management of Change, Supplier Performance Management, Wells technology delivery, Control of work, Cost management, Digital cybersecurity

Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get things done with urgency and focus.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will have a unique opportunity to shape the core technology behind our chat-driven platform. You will work on Felix Pago’s Chat Platform — a sophisticated system that not only processes high volumes of transactions but also delivers conversational experiences through integrated chatbots and natural language interfaces.   • We are technology agnostic and value candidates with diverse backgrounds. While familiarity with the following is helpful, your willingness to learn and adapt is paramount:

  • Collaboration & Mentorship: Foster the growth of junior developers through mentorship and best practice implementation, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including product, UX/UI, and business units.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to build, ship, and iterate on software applications with an emphasis on real-world impact.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures.
  • Experience with web services, including SOAP and REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with architectural patterns like Hexagonal Architecture, Event Driven Architecture, A/B Testing, Feature Flags, and Gradual Rollouts.
  • Conversational Experience: Demonstrated experience in building chatbots, conversational interfaces, or integrating natural language processing (NLP) tools. Familiarity with chatbot frameworks (e.g., DialogFlow, IBM Watson, Rasa) is a plus.
  • Passion for building products that positively impact millions.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and exploration of new technologies.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute actively with innovative ideas.
  • Excellent prioritization skills.
  • Curiosity and/or experience in Fintech is an added advantage (though equivalent competencies will also be considered).
